text:
leah: heads-up: found a subtle dup path in billing where claim+finalize can both make it to accounting during rapid retries. saw two customers hit duplicate debits in canary.

vikas: yeah we've hit that when the finalizer gets retried after a claim replay. current dedupe relies on claim_id which can be reissued.

jon: rough idea: emit a single canonical billing event (schema v2) that is the source-of-truth. make claim a local ephemeral.

emily: requirement: we still want a realtime "inflight" metric for dashboards. how will we show pending credits without an external claim event?

leah: plan: sidecar still records claim locally and exposes a /metrics endpoint for dashboards. externally we emit a single `billing_finalized_v2` with a compact proof bundle.

vikas: what goes in proof bundle? need enough to reconstruct provenance for audits/backfills but small enough to keep Kinesis costs down.

jon: proposal: proof_bundle = [req_digest, prefix_digest, final_digest] (sha256 truncated to 8 bytes each) + replay_source (live|backfill) + schema_version. that's ~3*8+small overhead ~28 bytes.

emily: ok. also add `dedupe_key` = sha256(req_id || final_digest) so ledger can dedupe idempotently without trusting claim_id.

metering-bot: branch "metering/single-finalize" pushed, CI green.

vikas: migration idea: run a 21-day mirror mode where we publish both old events and v2 final (header x-metering-mirror:true). consumers can opt into v2. after 21d flip to v2-only.

jon: agree. add per-tenant feature flag so we can flip risky customers individually.

leah: backfill handling: backfills should set replay_source=backfill and include original_event_ts if available. ledger will treat backfills as idempotent upsert keyed by dedupe_key + replay_source.

emily: analytics: we'll need a join key change. i'll prepare a migration script to rehydrate dashboards from mirror mode.

vikas: tests: i wrote a deterministic race sim `./dev/tools/sim_retries.py --seed 7 --iterations 10k` that exercises claim/finalize races. adding asserts for zero duplicate ledger writes.

leah: perf: estimated addl bytes per event ~40B. at 200M events/month that's ~8GB - fine. storage/ingest cost modeled in RFC.

jon: failure modes: if sidecar loses local claim store, we still emit finalize with proof_bundle. replay tooling needs fallback to reconstruct from logs. add a compaction TTL 48h for claim store.

emily: alerts: create SLO alert for unexpected "duplicate_charge_rate" > 0.01% during mirror. i'll wire dashboards to track dedupe_key collisions.

vikas: update audit-replay: if proof_bundle present, use proof_bundle to rebuild; else fall back to claim event. i'll add backfill handler.

leah: i'll draft the RFC follow-up today with schema examples, mirror plan, per-tenant rollout, tests, canary checklist, and rollback steps. pinging @vikas @emily for review.

metering-bot: canary deploy queued for staging in 10m.

jon: thanks. small ask: include a migration checklist for third-party consumers (kafka clients) to switch to dedupe_key joins.

emily: will do. also, we should run a 7-day prod canary after staging mirroring looks stable.

vikas: LGTM on approach.

leah: good. i'll post the RFC link once it's up.
